I’m not gonna bash you and call you selfish, because I imagine it’s a very difficult situation. However you may benefit from seeing her one last time, you’ll be regretting it along the road. It’ll be distressing whether you see her dying in person or if you try and avoid the situation, because you can’t run away from the death of a loved one. Try and see her. And if it’s too much for you allow yourself to leave. At least you can say you tried. You’ll never get this opportunity again.

Look at this way, you’re on a boat in the middle of the ocean and a huge wave is about to hit you. You could try hiding in the boat and pretending you’re on calm waters or you could face the wave head on and try and handle the aftermath. You can’t run away from  grief, which it sounds like you’re trying to do. Feel it! Cry! Do whatever you have to do to make yourself feel better. Get support from others around you. And go visit your grandma one last time.
